findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 20 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 122 questions numbered 1-122; by section: 20.1 16, 20.1.1 11, 20.1.2 11, 20.2 14, 20.3 8, 20.3.1 25, 20.4 13, 20.4.1 4, 20.4.2 10, 20.4.3 10. Covers every section 20.1-20.4.3 in order (structure of benzene and Kekule's structure, heats of hydrogenation and resonance energy, atomic orbital structure, nomenclature, reactivity compared with alkanes and alkenes, electrophilic aromatic substitution: halogenation, nitration, Friedel-Crafts alkylation and acylation, orientation by meta and ortho-para directors, combustion, side-chain oxidation, addition reactions). Numbers (resonance energy with new values, Å to pm, combustion moles, molar mass of C₆H₆Cl₆) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: resonance energy 152 kJ mol⁻¹ (not 158.5), C–H bond sp²–s, 1,4 = para, [AlBr₄]⁻ deprotonates in bromination, δ+/δ− partial charges, cyclohexene adds bromine readily, KMnO₄ test does not separate primary from secondary alkyl groups.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
